name: browse-action
description: Drive a real browser toward a goal: read pages, follow links, fill and submit forms. Every page is read as untrusted data, every navigation passes the BROWSE egress policy, and a run that exhausts its steps or its budget stops and asks you rather than guessing.
author: PersonalClaw

x-meta.label: Goal
x-meta.help: What to accomplish, in a sentence. The agent stops when it judges this done.

x-meta.label: Start URL
x-meta.help: The first page to load. Checked against the BROWSE egress policy before it opens.

x-meta.label: Step limit
x-meta.help: How many actions the agent may take. On reaching it the run stops and asks you, keeping its notes.

x-meta.label: Browser page target
x-meta.help: The Chrome DevTools WebSocket URL of the tab to drive (ws://127.0.0.1:9222/devtools/page/...). Without one the action refuses instead of pretending to browse.

x-meta.label: Screenshot folder
x-meta.help: Optional. Where per-step screenshots are written. They are referenced by path and never pasted into the model's context.
